title: plugin-detail: record:related_list reads its declared actions and renders them on the related list, host-bridge actions as the default (objectstack#20665 ruling ENFORCE)
body:
Child of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665, filed by the director seat (objectstack#12708, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`) on the maintainer's ruling **ENFORCE** (batch #247, 2026-09-30, 「业务上需要支持，ENFORCE」; the ruling record is on objectstack#20665). objectstack#20665 is `pm:blocked` on this card. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ruling decided

`record:related_list.actions` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1285`, "Action IDs available for related records") is declared, published and parsed, and no renderer reads it. Under ruling A′ ④ (#18900) the maintainer chose ENFORCE on business need: a related list carries its own action buttons, as a Salesforce related list does (the standard `New` plus custom list buttons), and CRM authoring — hotcrm's included — configures actions per list.

## What this card builds (objectui `plugin-detail`, `record-related-list.tsx`)

- The renderer reads `schema.actions`: each action ID resolves through the existing action registry and renders on the list.
- **Host-bridge actions stay the default** when `actions` is absent; when the author declares `actions`, the authored list is what renders (the composition rule the maintainer's letter implies — the seat states it in the PR and pins it).
- An action ID the registry cannot resolve is refused loudly where the registry resolves it (an author-visible refusal, never a silently dropped button).
- The parity ledger's last exemption, `NO_READ_SITE_TO_PIN` for this key (`apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`), becomes a member pin, and `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTION_CEILING` goes `1 → 0`.
- Pins: authored actions render in order; absent `actions` renders the host default; an unresolvable ID is refused; the parity ledger holds no exemption.

## Measurement the seat records first (it no longer flips the word)

Whether the host bridge already offers a per-list action configuration. If it does, the PR states how the two channels compose (authored `actions` wins, the bridge is the default) rather than treating the key as a duplicate; the maintainer's letter is ENFORCE either way.

## After landing

objectstack#20665 closes: the spec key is unchanged, its liveness row flips to `live` with this pin as the read site.

Related: objectstack#20665 (the ruling), objectui#8071 (the parity population), objectui#7300 (the closed tracker this replaces), objectui#11113 (slice 18, the ceiling at 1).
